title: Homotopy-limit cones via injective fibrant replacement
statement: Use the model-category conventions of [lem-coef-reedy-model-structure]. Let $A$ be a small ordinary category, let $H:A\to\mathcal M$ be a diagram, and let $c$ be a cone with vertex $C$. A diagram $R$ is injectively fibrant if $R\to *$ has the right lifting property against every objectwise trivial cofibration. The cone $c$ is homotopy limiting if there exist such an $R$ and an objectwise weak equivalence $j:H\to R$ for which the canonical composite $C\to\lim_A H\xrightarrow{\lim_A j}\lim_A R$ is a weak equivalence. This is the strict-limit-after-injective-replacement definition; it includes empty $A$ and imposes no enrichment.
